system.description:
Genjutsu you cast strike the precise cluster of nerves in your opponent’s brain forcing them to experience exactly what you want. You gain the following benefits:

When you cast a Genjutsu that requires an attack roll and miss, you can spend your Bonus action to remake the attack roll with advantage. Once you use this effect, you cannot do so again until you spend a Bonus action recharging this feature.

When you score a critical hit with a Genjutsu attack, the affected creature cannot react to this attacks damage, and they lose their reaction until the beginning of their next turn.

Evocation Technique – Double Frequency. While wielding a Combat Scroll, when you cast a Genjutsu that requires an attack, you can spend your Bonus action to make one Combat Scroll attack against the same creature. If both the triggering Genjutsu and the Combat Scroll attacks hit, then the next time the affected creature makes a Saving throw, they must use their lowest saving throw bonus, in place of their listed bonus.
system.requirement: Have a Genjutsu that requires an attack roll on your known list.
